messages:
jen: incident-bot just opened an alert: vanguard-enterprise-dedicated-eu-1 reporting a spike of 5xx from 14:02 UTC. customer-affecting? @sam @maya
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • ID: INC-42876 • Severity: P2 • Affected service: dedicated-gpu-eu-1 • Symptoms: 502/504 for RPCs to inference-proxy
sam: I'm on it, grabbing logs and tracer. starting runbooks: dedicated-fallback -> check routing policies
maya: I see elevated 5xx rate in the proxy logs, looks correlated with a backend model change roll from last night. error: "kvcache miss leading to OOM" in runtime logs. sharing snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:01:58Z runtime ERROR kv_cache.cpp:254 OOM while allocating 256MB
proxy  -> upstream 502
```
luis: tagging Vanguard impacted accounts list now. quick check: Vanguard Financials (acct_vanguard_001) has heavy traffic hitting eu region from 13:50 UTC, ~2.3k req/min.
jen: comms — do we want a tailored heads-up to the Vanguard ops team now? they have an SLA and reserved capacity on Dedicated.
comms: yes please. short status email: 1) what happened, 2) what we are doing, 3) ETA. keep it <5 lines. we also need a short status page blurb. can you draft?
sam: mitigation in flight: rolling revert of last night's model variant on dedicated-eu nodes, and constraining kv cache growth. running canary rollback to 3 nodes now.
luis: routing-wise we can failover Vanguard's dedicated pool to their reserved fallback capacity in us-west temporarily, but that will add latency ~200ms. need Vanguard approval to change region.
jen: draft for Vanguard ops (short):
"We detected increased 5xx responses for your dedicated EU pool starting ~13:50 UTC. Our engineers are rolling back a model deployment and applying cache constraints. We can failover your reserved workload to us‑west to restore success rates with an expected latency increase of ~200ms. No data loss expected. ETA for EU restore: 30–45m. — Redwood On‑Call"
comms: good start. change "detected" -> "experienced" and add link to incident page. also add POC phone number for immediate coordination.
jen: updated: "Vanguard experienced elevated 5xx responses for the dedicated EU pool starting ~13:50 UTC. Engineers are rolling back a model deployment and applying cache constraints. We can failover your reserved workload to US‑West to restore success rates with an expected latency increase of ~200ms. No data loss expected. ETA for EU restore: 30–45m. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-42876. For urgent coordination call +1-555-0102."
alex: FYI legal asked to confirm no customer data was processed differently — sam, any access pattern changes?
sam: no sign of data exfil or schema change. this is runtime memory pressure and routing failures only. logging flagged only internal errors.
ops-bot: NOTE: Created on-call handoff: current oncall sam -> next oncall maya at 15:00 UTC. Please include residual mitigation steps in the handoff note.
maya: taking this at handoff. planner: after rollback completes, run a 15m soak with increased KV cache eviction threshold and monitor 5xx rate for 30m before fully resuming the model variant rollout.
luis: I pushed a routing rule draft to the Vanguard account page: /accounts/vanguard_001/routing-drafts. tagging @comms to review customer-facing phrasing.
comms: I'll prepare both a status page update and an email template. Email subject suggestion: "Redwood Incident: Vanguard - Dedicated EU latency & errors (INC-42876)". Will ping when ready for send. :email:
jen: thanks all. final quick checklist before handoff: 1) rollback in canary (sam) 2) KV constraints applied (sam) 3) Vanguard ops notified draft (comms) 4) failover authorized? (vanguard ops) 5) handoff note posted (ops-bot/maya)
sam: canary rollback successful on 3 nodes, errors dropped 80% on those nodes. rolling to remaining nodes now.
maya: posting handoff note in incident doc and taking ownership. I'll coordinate with @luis on account-specific failover if Vanguard authorizes.
jen: if Vanguard authorizes region failover, ops please confirm expected timeline and knob to rollback back to EU once stable.
luis: estimate failover + verification ~12–18 minutes if approved. rollback back to EU ~20–30 minutes after stabilization.
comms: status page draft: "Investigating: Customers using devoted EU capacity may experience 502/504 errors and increased latencies while we rollback a model deployment and adjust cache settings. We have initiated mitigations; restoration expected within 30–45 minutes. Account-level notifications will be sent to affected customers."
jen: good. I'll send the Vanguard ops draft once comms confirm language. leave anything sensitive out of the public status.
sam: monitoring shows 5xx trending down cluster-wide. will update in 5m or sooner.
maya: noted. handing off to me for the next hour — will escalate to SRE manager if errors don't normalize to baseline by 15:30 UTC.
jen: thanks team. keep short updates here and add key actions to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
